As a backup for such an emergency I have a 1993 6.5TD Sierra 3/4 with the mechanical fuel pump with no electronics, they use the same DB2 injection pump in the marine version of the 6.5TD. The military Humvees/H1 Hummers use the same engine with mechanical pump which makes them EMP proof. The stock 6.5TD is not as powerful as the Duramax but is much better on fuel. The alternator with the bridge rectifier can be succeptible to an EMP but its easy to replace. You can keep a spare in a sealed metal container.
